description: No clean concept. Clearest case: early in the game (about 4-5 stones) when the opponent has just dropped a stone into an empty column 4 (bottom row), which fires almost always unless column 4, 5 or 1 already holds stones. Otherwise it fires sporadically, mostly right after the opponent stacks in column 5 (rows 3-4) or at ply 5, with no consistent board pattern; activation generally fades as the board fills.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes every column's probability by at most 0.02 on 7 positions.
notes: Layer 1 unit. Act sweeps: ply-4 openings ending with an opponent stone at (0,4) fire in 173/216 cases; col-4 already occupied kills it; ply-4 with any other last column never fired. Mid-game firing is diffuse across last-move cells (enriched at (2,5),(3,5),(0,3),(1,3),(3,4),(2,1)) and depends on context with no motif. Dev: p1 F1 0.231 (P 0.18, R 0.33), AUROC 0.64, sim share 0.07; a weighted variant did not improve (F1 0.223). Possibly a random direction. Synthesis only ties the dev max (0,2,0,4 = 1.287). Process note: once, I saved about 2,800 dev example lines to make a last-cell histogram by band, then deleted the file.
